text:
alex: quick rollout check-in — kicked off gateway feature-flag v2 canary at 10% in us-west ~5m ago. What I did: enabled flag and updated smart-routing. Blockers: seeing some 504s in one AZ (us-west-2a). Today: monitor telemetry, coordinate infra, and expand to 30% if stable.
maria: looking at traces now, spike in `proxy_worker` CPU aligns with 504 window. grabbing logs and p95/p99 traces. will paste snippets if I see obvious errors.
sasha: added a quick runbook note — if 504s persist >5m, revert with: `rwdctl flags set gateway-ff v2 off --env prod`. keeping the rollback steps handy.
derek: trying to repro locally but no luck. @priya can you check LB health + connection counts for us-west-2a? will hold expansion for now.
priya: LB health checks are green. I see user-facing 504s in the access logs though, not from the health checks. paused any further expansion. paging oncall. @deploy-bot can you snapshot current canary state?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary snapshot created -> id=cs-2026-03-17-01, included routes + flag state.
sasha: pinging QA — test plan updated (focus: session stickiness, KV-cache, retries). @qa-bot please run smoke suite against canary group id cs-2026-03-17-01.
qa-bot: qa-bot: smoke tests triggered for cs-2026-03-17-01. Progress: 12/45 tests passed so far; failures concentrated on session timeout and a couple cache misses.
maria: correlating traces — the 504s map to long tail redis GET latency in us-west-2a. looks like transient network flaps to cache nodes. provisioning a standby cache node in that AZ now.
derek: proposed plan: keep canary at 10%, bring up standby cache node, add proxy retry (3 tries) for next 1h. If error rate <0.1% for a continuous 20m window, expand to 30%. otherwise, roll back to 0%.
alex: :thumbsup: I’ll coordinate infra and approvals. tagging infra on-call to speed provisioning. if error rate increases, we revert immediately.
priya: oncall acknowledged. I’ll monitor LB and alert thresholds, and will post any paging. share IP ranges if infra needs them.
sasha: FYI we annotated the flag with `rollout=canary-gateway-v2` and region tags. can toggle per-region: `rwdctl flags set gateway-ff v2 us-west-2a off` if needed.
maria: update: after adding standby cache node and warmup, redis tail latency dropped and 504s returned to baseline. QA retriggered — now 41/45 tests passing. recommend expand to 30% in 15m.
alex: proceeding with 30% expansion at T+15m. I’ll post back after the 30m observation window.
derek: APIM side looks clear — no regressions observed. calling out: if anyone sees an uptick, post here and I’ll roll it back.
priya: monitoring dashboards are green for the moment. will escalate if thresholds hit.
qa-bot: qa-bot: second run results: 41/45 passed, 4 flaky session timeouts investigated. marking two as flaky and requeueing remaining.
alex: 30% rolled out, 30m window completed, no new alerts. keeping the flag at 30% and scheduling the next expansion tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone for the quick turn. :tada:
